# Requirements Checklist: the dock's entry headers expand and collapse their own block

**Spec**: `specs/198-dock-entry-toggle/spec.md` · **Created**: 2026-11-18 · **Depth**: Standard

*Generated by the agent; never ticked by the agent. All 20 items were ticked at **Gate 2,
2026-11-18**, on the owner's word ("tick and accept all"); every finding A1-A8 was accepted in
the same reply (see `analysis.md` History).*

## Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the request's "entry header" pinned to a concrete element — the `button.entryrow`
  line itself, with the chevron a descendant span and no wrapper or sibling control?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-011/A11]
- [x] CHK002 Are the block's states (open/closed) and the third fact (live) each given an
  unambiguous source — `effectiveOpen = live ? open : (override ?? closed)`, crossings,
  `sync()` — with one painter per place? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006/Key Entities]
- [x] CHK003 Are the entries that render no chevron named by the rule that excludes them (section
  break, empty inner), and are media entries explicitly included? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-010/A6/US3-AC4]
- [x] CHK004 Is the live entry's lock complete across every affordance — no chevron, header click
  no-op, block open, stored override inert — with no half-state left to guess?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-002/FR-006/US1-AC3]
- [x] CHK005 Is the projection trigger set enumerated exhaustively (screen rows, Next band, bait
  chips, transport — headers excluded), so "headers never project" has no silent fourth path?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/US2-AC4]

## Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the toggle morph quantified — 230 ms, `easeInOut(t)`, the property animated, the
  `.is-morph` suppression, and the reduce case — rather than "animated"? [Measurability, Spec
  §FR-005/UI-UX]
- [x] CHK007 Is the chevron quantified — viewBox `0 0 20 20`, stroke 1.7 round, 15 × 15 px, ink
  via `currentColor`, right at rest / 90° down open, 200 ms `var(--ease)` flip — rather than
  "a chevron"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003/UI-UX]
- [x] CHK008 Is the chevron's vertical centring quantified and evidenced (`align-self: center`
  because the row aligns by baseline; probe offset 0 px), not left as taste? [Measurability, Spec
  §UI-UX chevron row — owner, 2026-11-18]
- [x] CHK009 Is "no display-state write" spelled into its observable parts (no `gkps-display`
  write, no `OBS-*` message, no `aria-current` change, no scroll)? [Measurability, Spec
  §FR-002/US2-AC4]
- [x] CHK010 Is the no-plus/minus prohibition stated as a rule with its verification (glyph sweep
  over the sheet and script)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003/SC-004]
